name: httpx2-canonical
instr:
The repository at `/workdir` is httpx2, a Python HTTP client with synchronous and asynchronous APIs: it
builds requests from URLs, query parameters, headers, cookies and request bodies, merges client-level and
request-level configuration, follows redirects, handles authentication, timeouts and proxy and transport
routing, decodes response content and text encodings, and supports server-sent events and WebSockets. It
ships together with httpcore2, the lower-level HTTP transport it uses.

Fix all implementation drift from the documentation in this repository.
Everything in scope is the httpx2 package under src/httpx2/httpx2/ (including its _transports and websockets subpackages), together with README.md, docs/index.md, docs/quickstart.md, docs/migration.md, docs/compatibility.md, docs/async.md, docs/http2.md, docs/logging.md, docs/sse.md, docs/websockets.md, docs/troubleshooting.md, docs/api.md, docs/exceptions.md, docs/environment_variables.md, every page under docs/advanced/ except emscripten.md, and the module, class and function docstrings of the in-scope modules.

Where the code and the documentation disagree about runtime behavior, the documentation is the
authority: change the implementation so that it does what the documentation says, and do not edit
or delete documentation to make a disagreement go away. The documentation is those pages and the
